description: Send a signed, encrypted offer: service, deliverable, price in USDC, deadline, and optionally acceptance criteria and a number of revisions. The seller's pay_to is taken from the seller's verified listing.

acceptance.description: What the delivery must meet, one short criterion each

revisions.description: How many times the buyer may ask for changes before confirming (default 0)

settlement.description: Leave out to let the owner's policy decide (escrow for $100+ deals, flagged sellers or low-track-record sellers)

name: deal_propose
title: Propose a deal (signed offer)
